visual_elements.description: Confusion matrix for Threshold=0.0. Columns are 'Predicted as' P and N; rows are 'Actual' P and N. Cells: Actual P / Predicted P = 5 in blue; Actual P / Predicted N = 0 in red; Actual N / Predicted P = 6 in red; Actual N / Predicted N = 0 in blue. To the right: TPR=5/(5+0)=1 in blue and FPR=6/(6+0)=1 in red.

Confusion matrix for Threshold=0.1. Columns are 'Predicted as' P and N; rows are 'Actual' P and N. Cells: Actual P / Predicted P = 5 in blue; Actual P / Predicted N = 0 in red; Actual N / Predicted P = 4 in red; Actual N / Predicted N = 2 in blue. To the right: TPR=5/(5+0)=1 in blue and FPR=4/(4+2)=.66 in red.

Confusion matrix for Threshold=0.3. Columns are 'Predicted as' P and N; rows are 'Actual' P and N. Cells: Actual P / Predicted P = 5 in blue; Actual P / Predicted N = 0 in red; Actual N / Predicted P = 2 in red; Actual N / Predicted N = 4 in blue. To the right: TPR=5/(5+0)=1 in blue and FPR=2/(2+4)=.33 in red.
Blue-bordered white box containing bold red text 'ROC Curve for Same Model - different thresholds'.
visual_elements.position: bottom band of left panel, right side

visual_elements.description: ROC-space plot. Vertical axis is labeled TPR with an upward arrow; horizontal axis is labeled FPR with a rightward arrow; both range from 0 to 1 with a light grid. A black diagonal arrow/line runs from lower-left toward upper-right. Three red-outlined circle markers are labeled '0.3' near the left side at about TPR=0.3, '1.0' at the upper-right corner, and '0.0' at the lower-right corner.

Formula and legend area. Left box shows TPR = TP/(TP+FN) and FPR = FP/(FP+TN) as stacked fractions. Right small matrix has 'Predicted as' P/N and 'Actual' P/N with cells TP and TN in green, FN and FP in red/pink.
Yellow circular slide-number badge with black text '31'.

typography_notes: Sans-serif throughout, Arial/Calibri-like. 'Threshold=' labels and matrix numbers are bold. TPR text and P-column numbers are blue; FPR text and N-column/FP/FN numbers are red. The title-like text is bold red inside a blue-outlined box. Axis labels and formula definitions are black. All-caps is used for TPR, FPR, TP, FN, FP, TN, ROC, P, and N.
animation_state: No mid-build state is evident; all matrices, formulas, ROC markers, and legend items are visible.
recreation_brief: 1. Set the slide background to white. 2. Create a large red-bordered panel on the left/center, roughly x 12%-73%, y 5%-90%, divided into four horizontal bands. 3. In the top three bands, add a small red-bordered label at the upper-left with the exact texts 'Threshold=0.0', 'Threshold=0.1', and 'Threshold=0.3' in red bold. 4. In each band, build a 2x2 confusion matrix: header 'Predicted as' over columns P and N; row header 'Actual' beside rows P and N. Use red borders, black header text, blue numbers in the P column, and red numbers in the N column. Fill the cells exactly: threshold 0.0 -> 5, 0, 6, 0; threshold 0.1 -> 5, 0, 4, 2; threshold 0.3 -> 5, 0, 2, 4. 5. To the right of each matrix, add two lines: 'TPR=5/(5+0)=1' in blue bold, and the matching FPR line in red bold: 'FPR=6/(6+0)=1', 'FPR=4/(4+2)=.66', 'FPR=2/(2+4)=.33'. 6. In the bottom band, leave an empty red-bordered box on the left and place a blue-bordered white-filled box on the right with bold red text 'ROC Curve for Same Model - different thresholds'. 7. On the right, add a red-bordered panel roughly x 74%-98%, y 5%-90%. In its upper half, draw an ROC plot: light grid, vertical axis labeled TPR with an up arrow, horizontal axis labeled FPR with a right arrow, a black diagonal arrow/line from lower-left to upper-right, and three red circle markers labeled '0.3', '1.0', and '0.0'. 8. In the lower half of the right panel, add the definitions 'TPR = TP/(TP+FN)' and 'FPR = FP/(FP+TN)' as fractions, plus a small legend matrix with TP and TN in green and FN and FP in red/pink. 9. Add a yellow circle at the top-right containing '31'. 10. Use a sans-serif font and keep all text verbatim; no animation is needed.
